items.title: Text as Strings in Python
items.content:
A **string** (`str`) is an ordered sequence of characters used to store text. In Python, you can enclose strings in:
- Single quotes: `'Alex'`
- Double quotes: `"Alex"`
- Triple quotes for multiline text: `"""Line 1
Line 2"""`

Single and double quotes are completely equivalent in Python.
items.explanation: Strings represent text data wrapped in matching quotes. Single, double, and triple quotes are all supported.
